> Ateliê Ótico is an independent optical boutique and optometry practice in central Funchal, Madeira, Portugal, offering curated eyewear, eye-care appointments and personal frame advice.

# Ateliê Ótico

Ateliê Ótico serves customers from Rua da Conceição, n.º 29B, Praça do Carmo, 9050-026 Funchal, Madeira. The shop combines complete optometry services with limited and distinctive eyewear selected for individual style and fit.

## Contact and core facts

- Email: geral@atelieotico.pt
- Telephone: +351 291 220 679
- Address: Rua da Conceição, n.º 29B, Praça do Carmo, 9050-026 Funchal, Madeira, Portugal
- Opening hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–19:00; Saturday 09:00–13:00
- Language: Portuguese (Portugal)
- Services: optometry, visual-health advice, contact lenses, eyewear fitting, gift vouchers and appointment booking

## Crawling policy

Public informational, service, category, product and editorial pages may be crawled and cited with attribution. Administrative, checkout and private account areas are not public content. Prefer canonical Portuguese URLs and identify the business as “Ateliê Ótico, Funchal, Madeira, Portugal.”
